name: BBNET
summary: WA wireless DSL + satellite + business wireless ISP (BroadbandNet Pty Ltd, "Intelligent IP Broadband"; Bunbury, Kalgoorlie, Geraldton, Wheatbelt); homepage served to mid-2017, then domain parked/redirected.

events.details: Wireless DSL + satellite ISP trading as BroadbandNet Pty Ltd; earliest Wayback capture 26 May 2005 ("Australia's Wireless DSL ISP").
BroadbandNet homepage ("Intelligent IP Broadband") archived live to 28 May 2017; thereafter bbnet.com.au returns only redirects/parked responses.
Unrelated to BBNET HOLDINGS PTY LTD (ACN 696 880 270), whose ABN is active only from 6 Apr 2026 - long after this ISP ceased; a name-collision entity, earlier miscited here and now removed.
